meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 vercel 命令把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel，并管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署前会先检查本地构建是否通过，部署后会用 curl 验证线上地址是否正常响应。
howto.when: 当你说要部署、发布或上线 Web 应用，或要求管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量等时触发。

say.text: 帮我部署这个项目到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude 会先本地构建，再运行部署并验证 URL。

say.text: 部署前先用 npm run build 检查能不能通过
say.note: 避免把构建失败的代码部署上去。

say.text: 把 API_KEY 这个变量加到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude 会用 echo 管道添加，避开交互提示。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel using the vercel CLI, and manage projects, domains, and environment variables. Before deploying, it checks the local build passes; after deploying, it verifies the live URL responds via curl.
howto.when_en: When asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, environment variables, etc.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude will build locally, deploy, then verify the URL.

say_en.text: Run npm run build first to check it passes.
Add the API_KEY variable to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Uses echo pipe to skip interactive prompts.
